title: FileLimits
description: `GET /files/limits`: the ceilings a client has to know before it starts — editing, download, zip, upload, history (plan 07, F7). Said before the client starts, so a refusal is a sentence on the screen before the transfer, not a `413` after it.

maxEditBytes.description: Above this, a file is not opened for editing at all, and a save is refused.

largeFileBytes.description: Above this, a file opens in the light mode of the editor.

downloadMaxBytes.description: The most bytes one download takes out: a file, or the measure of a zip.

archiveMaxEntries.description: The most entries one zip carries.

uploadMaxBytes.description: The largest file one upload writes.

uploadMaxEntries.description: The most files one upload writes.

uploadMaxTotalBytes.description: The most bytes one upload writes, all files together.

historyMaxFileBytes.description: Above this, a version is not kept, and its entry says so.
